easyPrerequisites: You haven't completed and are not currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation.
description:
Cast Acererak the Archlich without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Acererak the Archlich enters, it triggers both of its abilities.
Resolve one Acererak ability, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the other Acererak ability, venturing into a dungeon that is not Tomb of Annihilation.
Repeat.
